tagShapeMismatches.english: Kas isn't in possession of the legendary artifact called the {@i Sword of Kas} during this adventure. However, if the characters wish to find it and use it against the warlord, you might place the artifact somewhere in this adventure for them to find. See the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG} for more information about the {@item Sword of Kas}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在這次冒險中，凱斯並沒有擁有被稱為{@i 凱斯之劍}的傳奇神器。然而，如果角色們希望找到它並用它來對抗軍閥，你可以在這次冒險的某個地方放置這個神器供他們尋找。有關{@item 凱斯之劍}的更多資訊，請參見{@book 城主指南|DMG}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The characters can learn three secrets in this chapter applicable to the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules found in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}. These secrets are tied to three NPCs whom the characters encounter in the Neverdeath Catacombs:
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在這一章中，角色們可以學到三個適用於本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則的秘密。這些秘密與角色在不死墓穴中遇到的三個NPC有關：

tagShapeMismatches.english: Learning of Sarcelle's vision counts as a secret for the purposes of the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules found in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 得知薩塞勒的幻象在這本書的{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中發現的{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則中被視為一個秘密。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The wheels control the water pressure through the pipes, but they lack gauges to show how turning the wheels affects the pressure. A character can determine that the water flows west, as well as how to maximize or minimize the water pressure, with an hour of trial and error. A character who succeeds on a {@dc 16} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check discovers this information in only 10 minutes. Alternatively, the {@creature marid} Shanzezim in {@area area C10|05c|x} can describe how to work the wheels.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 輪子透過管道控制水壓，但它們缺少儀表來顯示轉動輪子如何影響水壓。一個角色可以透過一小時的試驗和錯誤來確定水流向西，以及如何最大化或最小化水壓。一個成功透過 {@dc 16} 智力 ({@skill 調查}) 檢定的角色可以在僅僅10分鐘內發現這個資訊。或者，位於 {@area 區域C10|05c|x} 的 {@creature 水巨靈} 珊澤辛 可以描述如何操作這些輪子。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Learning about Umberto's secret research topic counts as a secret for the purposes of the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 瞭解翁貝託的秘密研究課題在這本書的{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中發現的{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則中被視為一個秘密。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Loud noise here rouses the two {@creature Mage||mages} dozing in {@area area C16|070|x}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這裡的大聲喧鬧會驚醒在{@area 區域C16|070|x}打盹的兩位{@creature 魔法師||魔法師們}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The collection of sinister books, many of which are duplicates, includes a few valuable tomes. A book describing the {@item Eye of Vecna} and {@item Hand of Vecna} is a masterpiece of writing and artistic illumination worth 450 gp. A book of nonsensical poetry titled Quite Good Verse has a gold-plated cover and is worth 200 gp. A book about Neverwinter's history contains a {@item Spell Scroll} of {@spell Greater Invisibility} and a {@item Spell Scroll} of {@spell Major Image} folded in its pages. The characters can find these treasures with 10 minutes of dedicated searching.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這些邪惡的書籍收藏中，有許多是副本，其中包括一些珍貴的書籍。一本描述了{@item 維克那法眼}和{@item 維克那魔掌}的書是寫作和藝術插圖的傑作，價值450金幣。一本標題為《相當不錯的詩篇》的無意義詩歌集有金質封面，價值200金幣。一本關於無冬城歷史的書在其頁面中夾有一張{@spell 高等隱形術}的{@item 法術卷軸}和一張{@spell 高等幻影}的{@item 法術卷軸}。角色們可以透過10分鐘的專注搜尋找到這些寶藏。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Learning Indrina's discovery counts as a secret for the purposes of the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}. Lord Neverember casually dismisses Indrina's accusation if it's later brought to his attention, insisting that the woman can't prove anything.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 瞭解因德里娜的發現在這本書的{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中發現的{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則中被視為一個秘密。如果後來有人向無燼領主提出因德里娜的指控，他會不以為意地駁回，堅稱那位女士無法證明任何事情。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The characters can learn two secrets in this chapter or later that are applicable to the rules in "{@area The Power of Secrets|028|x}" section in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}:
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 角色們可以在這一章或之後的章節中瞭解到兩個適用於本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中"秘密的力量{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}"部分規則的秘密：

tagShapeMismatches.english: If the characters find out at any point in this adventure that Mordenkainen is Kas in disguise, it counts as a secret for the purposes of the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果在這次冒險的任何時候，角色們發現魔鄧肯實際上是偽裝的凱斯，這將被視為本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中提到的{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則的秘密。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If the characters confront Kas before chapter 9, allow the battle to play out using the stat block for {@creature Kas the Betrayer|VEoR|Kas} in {@adventure appendix B|VEoR|13}. If Kas defeats the characters, he kills them and absconds to Pandemonium. Alustriel has the clerics of Silverymoon bring the characters back to life, apologetic for not discovering Kas's ruse and angry she was duped. Alustriel suspects Kas knows where Vecna weaves his ritual and encourages the characters to follow the vampire to Pandemonium when they can.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果角色們在第9章之前面對凱斯，允許使用{@adventure 附錄 B|VEoR|13}中{@creature 背叛者凱斯|VEoR|凱斯}的資料塊來進行戰鬥。如果凱斯擊敗了角色們，他會殺死他們並逃往混沌之域。艾拉斯卓讓銀月城的牧師們使角色們復活，對於沒有發現凱斯的詭計感到歉意，並對自己被欺騙感到憤怒。艾拉斯卓懷疑凱斯知道維克那編織儀式的地點，並鼓勵角色們在能夠的時候跟隨吸血鬼前往混沌之域。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The doors in Web's Edge are made of iron. The doors to {@area areas W3|10a|x}, {@area W4|10e|x}, and {@area W5|111|x} are sealed with {@spell Arcane Lock} spells, requiring a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check using thieves' tools to unlock. Additionally, areas W6a–W6d are locked and each require a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check using thieves' tools to unlock. The {@creature nalfeshnee} in {@area area W5|111|x} carries keys to all the cells in {@area area W6|114|x}. All other doors in Web's Edge are unlocked.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在網緣之門由鐵製成。通往 {@area 區域W3|10a|x}、{@area W4|10e|x} 和 {@area W5|111|x} 的門都被{@spell 秘法鎖}法術封印，需要成功透過{@dc 20} 敏捷（{@skill 巧手}）檢定並使用盜賊工具來解鎖。此外，區域 W6a–W6d 被鎖上，每個區域都需要成功透過{@dc 15} 敏捷（{@skill 巧手}）檢定並使用盜賊工具來解鎖。位於{@area 區域W5|111|x}的{@creature 判魂魔}攜帶著{@area 區域W6|114|x}中所有牢房的鑰匙。網緣的其他門都是未上鎖的。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The walls in Web's Edge are rocky, jagged, and uneven. Decades ago, Lolth's faithful enlarged the chamber that contains Sacred Web Hall ({@area area W12|130|x}) using the {@spell Stone Shape} spell. As such, the walls in area W12 are smooth.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 蛛網之緣的牆壁是岩石質地的，參差不齊且不平整。幾十年前，洛斯的信徒使用{@spell 塑石術}法術擴大了包含聖網大廳（{@area 區域W12|130|x}）的房間。因此，W12區域的牆壁是平滑的。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Regardless of the characters' reaction to this revelation, learning it counts for the purposes of the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}. The mining operation is the same one the cultists in {@area area W7|123|x} are discussing.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 無論角色們對這個揭示的反應如何，瞭解它都算作本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則的目的。這個採礦作業與{@area 區域W7|123|x}中的邪教徒正在討論的是同一個。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The characters can learn two secrets in this chapter that are applicable to the rules in "{@area The Power of Secrets|028|x}" section in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}:
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 角色們可以在這一章中學到兩個秘密，這兩個秘密適用於本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中的"{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}"部分的規則：

tagShapeMismatches.english: Regardless of the characters' reaction to this revelation, learning it counts as a secret for the purposes of the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 無論角色們對這個揭示有何反應，瞭解它都算作本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則的秘密。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Regardless of what the characters do on learning this, it counts as a secret for the purposes of the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 無論角色在獲知此事後採取何種行動，根據本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中的{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則，這都算作一個秘密。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Inda has a {@item Flame Tongue shortsword} and a {@item Ring of Evasion} on her bedside table next to the {@item Lantern of Revealing}. If asked, Inda is reluctant to give away the shortsword or ring but can be convinced with a successful {@dc 22} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check. Inda has a key to the strongbox in {@area area Z13|177|x} and knows where the secret compartment holding a {@item Spell Scroll} of {@spell Flame Strike} is in {@area area Z17|184|x}; she mentions these to the characters if they help her with her prosthetic wing in area Z16 or help her reach her crew in the stern segment.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 印達的床頭櫃上放著一把{@item 焰舌短劍}和一枚{@item 反射閃避戒指}，旁邊還有一盞{@item 顯像提燈}。如果被問及，印達不太願意交出短劍或戒指，但如果成功透過{@dc 22}魅力（{@skill 遊說}）檢定，可以說服她。印達有一個鑰匙可以開啟位於{@area 區域Z13|177|x}的保險箱，並且知道在{@area 區域Z17|184|x}中藏有{@item 法術卷軸}的{@spell 焰擊術}的秘密隔間；如果角色在區域 Z16 幫助她修復假翼或幫助她抵達船尾段的同伴，她會向角色提及這些資訊。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The characters can learn two secrets in this chapter that are applicable to the rules in "{@area The Power of Secrets|028|x}" section in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}:
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 角色們可以在這一章中學到兩個秘密，這兩個秘密適用於本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中的"{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}"部分的規則：

tagShapeMismatches.english: Regardless of the characters' reaction to this revelation, learning it counts as a secret for the purposes of {@area the Power of Secrets|028|x} rules in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 不論角色們對這個揭示的反應如何，瞭解到這一點在本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則的目的上算作一個秘密。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Regardless of the characters' reaction to this revelation or whether they offer to look for Filch, learning it counts as a secret for the purposes of {@area the Power of Secrets|028|x} rules in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 不論角色們對這個啟示的反應如何，或者他們是否提出尋找Filch，瞭解這一點在本書的{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中的{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則下都被視為一個秘密。

tagShapeMismatches.english: For each ounce of graymatter fluid consumed, the creature takes 11 ({@dice 2d10}) psychic damage. A creature killed by this damage rises as a {@creature zombie} {@dice 1d4} hours after dying.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 生物每喝下一盎司灰質流體，就受到11（{@dice 2d10}）點心靈傷害。被這種傷害殺死的生物，會在死亡{@dice 1d4}小時後化為{@creature zombie}起身。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Three Cyran soldiers in full regalia stand diligently at the arrow slits in this 30-foot-tall gathering hall. When they become aware of the characters, the soldiers turn to the party, revealing ghostly, screaming skulls instead of faces. The soldiers are three hostile {@creature Wight||wights}. Three {@creature Will-o'-Wisp||will-o'-wisps}, previously {@condition invisible}, appear at the start of combat and fight alongside the wights.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 三名身著全套軍服的塞爾士兵，在這座高30尺的集會大廳中守在箭孔旁。察覺角色們後，士兵轉過身來，露出的不是臉孔，而是幽靈般尖叫的骷髏頭。這三名士兵是敵對的{@creature Wight||屍妖}。三隻原本處於{@condition invisible||隱形}狀態的{@creature Will-o'-Wisp||鬼火}會在戰鬥開始時現身，與屍妖並肩作戰。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If any character consents to the graymatter engine's secret-learning process, the most recent secret the party learned is spent, as described in "{@area The Power of Secrets|028|x}" section in the book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}. Instead of the usual benefit of spending the secret, the characters all gain {@book inspiration|PHB|4|inspiration}. Mark off a secret spent in this way on the Secrets Tracker in {@adventure appendix C|VEoR|14}. No matter how many characters consent, only one secret is spent.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果有角色同意灰質引擎的秘密學習過程，隊伍最近學到的秘密就會像書中{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}的"{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}"部分所描述的那樣被消耗掉。與通常消耗秘密的好處不同，角色們都會獲得{@book 激勵|PHB|4|激勵}。在{@adventure 附錄C|VEoR|14}的秘密追蹤器上標記以這種方式消耗的秘密。無論有多少角色同意，都只會消耗一個秘密。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The characters can learn one secret in this chapter that is applicable to the rules in "{@area The Power of Secrets|028|x}" section in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}:
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 角色們可以在這個章節中學到一個適用於本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中的"{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}"部分規則的秘密：

tagShapeMismatches.english: Before the characters enter Death House, make sure the players understand their goals. The characters can't leave until they encounter {@creature Strahd, Master of Death House|VEoR|Strahd von Zarovich}, as described in the "{@area Leaving the House|2b9|x}" section later in this chapter.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在角色們進入死亡之屋之前，確保玩家們理解他們的目標。角色們在本章後面的'{@area 離開房子|2b9|x}'部分描述的遇到{@creature 施特拉德，死亡之主|VEoR|施特拉德·馮·扎洛維奇}之前不能離開。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Regardless of the characters' reaction to this revelation, learning it counts as a secret for the purposes of the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 無論角色們對這個揭示有何反應，瞭解它都算作本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則的秘密。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The characters can learn two secrets in this chapter that are applicable to the rules in "{@area The Power of Secrets|028|x}" section in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}:
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 角色們可以在這一章中學到兩個秘密，這兩個秘密適用於本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中的"{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}"部分的規則：

tagShapeMismatches.english: The {@creature deadbark dryad|VEoR} bitterly recounts the tale of Lord Soth's soldiers assaulting the tree. If a character tries to comfort Gazaia, she confesses that she hid while the soldiers were around the tree. Gazaia feels extremely guilty that she didn't defend her charge. Regardless of the characters' reaction to this revelation, learning it counts as a secret for the purposes of the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@creature 枯皮樹精|VEoR}苦澀地講述了索斯勳爵計程車兵襲擊樹木的故事。如果一個角色試圖安慰加扎亞，她會承認自己在士兵們圍在樹邊時躲了起來。加扎亞對自己沒有保護好自己負責的樹感到極度內疚。無論角色們對這一揭露有何反應，瞭解到這一點都算作一個秘密，符合本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則的目的。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Regardless of the characters' reaction to this revelation, learning it counts as a secret for the purposes of the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 無論角色們對這個揭示有何反應，瞭解它都算作本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則的秘密。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Heaped on this vault's floor are Valendar's belongings, including his leather armor, a {@item Potion of Greater Healing||Potion of Healing (greater)}, a {@item Spell Scroll} of {@spell Stoneskin}, and a brilliant-blue cloak emblazoned with the holy symbol of Habbakuk.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這個金庫的地板上堆滿了瓦倫達爾的個人物品，包括他的皮甲、一瓶{@item 高等治療藥水||治療藥水（高等）}、一張{@spell 石膚術}的{@item 法術卷軸}，以及一件飾有哈巴庫克聖徽的鮮藍色斗篷。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The characters can learn two secrets in this chapter that are applicable to the rules in "{@area The Power of Secrets|028|x}" section in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}:
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 角色們可以在這一章中學到兩個秘密，這兩個秘密適用於本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中的"{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}"部分的規則：

tagShapeMismatches.english: Marian has a {@item Lantern of Revealing} sitting near her and a {@item Gem of Seeing} strapped to her belt. If asked, she lends the characters the lantern but is hesitant to lend the gem. A character can convince her to lend them the {@item Gem of Seeing} by succeeding on a {@dc 18} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 瑪麗安身邊放著一盞{@item 顯像提燈}，腰間掛著一顆{@item 真視寶石}。如果被請求，她會借給角色們那盞燈，但對於借出寶石則猶豫不決。角色可以透過一次{@dc 18}魅力（{@skill 遊說}）檢定成功說服她借出{@item 真視寶石}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Regardless of the characters' reaction to this revelation, learning it counts as a secret for the purposes of the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 無論角色們對這個揭示有何反應，瞭解它都算作本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則的秘密。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A character who searches the desk and succeeds on a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check discovers that one of its drawers contains a locked false bottom. Rerak (see {@area area T26|3e4|x}) carries the key to this compartment, but a character with thieves' tools can use them to try to unlock the compartment, doing so with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check. A {@spell Knock} spell or similar magic also unlocks the compartment.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個角色如果搜查這張書桌並且在智力（{@skill 調查}）檢定中成功透過 {@dc 20}，會發現其中一個抽屜有一個上鎖的假底。雷拉克（參見 {@area 區域T26|3e4|x}）攜帶這個隔間的鑰匙，但一個擁有盜賊工具的角色可以使用它們來嘗試解鎖這個隔間，透過成功的 {@dc 20} 敏捷（{@skill 巧手}）檢定即可完成。一個 {@spell 敲擊術} 法術或類似的魔法也能解鎖這個隔間。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Regardless of the characters' reaction to this revelation, learning it counts as a secret for the purposes of the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 無論角色們對這個揭示有何反應，瞭解它都算作本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則的秘密。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The individuals the characters meet in Avernus are primarily Fiends and other unpleasant beings. As a rule, these creatures lack the remorse, guilt, and shame that would give their secrets power if revealed to the characters. The characters don't learn any secrets applicable to the rules in "{@area The Power of Secrets|028|x}" section found in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}, though they can spend secrets during this chapter normally.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 角色們在阿弗納斯遇到的個體主要是惡魔和其他不愉快的生物。通常，這些生物缺乏悔恨、內疚和羞恥感，如果這些秘密被揭露給角色們，它們將具有力量。角色們在這個章節中不會學到適用於本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中"{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}"部分規則的任何秘密，儘管他們可以像平常一樣在這一章中使用秘密。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A character who succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check notices a flicker of hunger appear in Kaylan's eyes when he mentions {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|Soul Coins}. If pressed, Kaylan admits that he feeds off {@i Soul Coins} using a special {@item Sword of Life Stealing}, which he always keeps with him. If the characters bring him {@i Soul Coins}, he'll give the characters 500 talons for each coin.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個成功透過 {@dc 15} 感知（{@skill 洞悉}）檢定的角色會注意到，當凱蘭提到 {@item 靈魂幣|BGDIA|靈魂幣} 時，他的眼中閃過一抹飢渴。如果被追問，凱蘭會承認他使用一把特殊的 {@item 竊命劍} 來吸食 {@i 靈魂幣}，他一直隨身攜帶著這把劍。如果角色們給他帶來 {@i 靈魂幣}，他會為每個錢幣支付 500 塔隆。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The characters can learn one secret in this chapter that is applicable to the rules in "{@area The Power of Secrets|028|x}" section in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}:
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 角色們可以在這個章節中學到一個適用於本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中的"{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}"部分規則的秘密：

tagShapeMismatches.english: Regardless of the characters' reaction to this revelation, learning it counts as a secret for the purposes of the rules in the "{@area Power of Secrets|028|x}" section in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 無論角色對這一真相作何反應，根據本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中"{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}"部分的規則，瞭解到這一點都將被視為一個秘密。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The characters can learn two secrets in this chapter applicable to the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules found in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}:
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 角色們可以在此章節中學習兩個與本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中提到的{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則相關的秘密：

tagShapeMismatches.english: If the characters cut or destroy the webbing, the falling tower smashes the creatures near the entrance to the Ruinous Citadel and obliterates most of the citadel's rooms (see the "Ruinous Citadel" section). Areas {@area Y3|4ad|x}–{@area Y6|4b9|x} are destroyed, along with the creatures and objects in them, and the creatures in {@area area Y1|4a8|x} are slain. Naxa in {@area area Y4|4af|x} manages to scamper along the ceiling into {@area area Y2|4ab|x}, though she hides there and won't reveal herself to the characters until the {@creature Phisarazu Spyder-Fiend|VEoR|phisarazu spyder-fiends} are dispatched. The {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} in {@area area Y7|4bb|x} is loosened from the stones, though the characters still need to manually pull the rod free to re-imprison Miska.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果角色們切斷或破壞了蛛網，倒塌的塔樓會摧毀入口附近的生物，並徹底摧毀毀滅堡壘的大部分房間（見"毀滅堡壘"部分）。區域{@area Y3|4ad|x}至{@area Y6|4b9|x}被毀，連同其中的生物和物品一併消失，而{@area 區域Y1|4a8|x}中的生物被殺死。在{@area 區域Y4|4af|x}的納克薩設法沿著天花板爬到{@area 區域Y2|4ab|x}，儘管她藏在那裡，直到{@creature 菲薩拉祖蜘蛛惡魔|VEoR|菲薩拉祖蜘蛛惡魔}被解決，她才會向角色們顯露自己。在{@area 區域Y7|4bb|x}的{@item 七碎片之杖|VEoR}從石頭中鬆動，儘管角色們仍需手動拔出法杖以重新監禁米斯卡。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A human corpse bears a platinum medallion of Lolth's symbol with dazzling diamonds at the end of each spider's foot (worth 3,000 gp). A drider corpse wears a bandolier woven of solidified shadow worth 30,000 gp. The bandolier holds two {@item Potion of Supreme Healing||Potions of Healing (supreme)} and a {@item Spell Scroll} of {@spell Seeming}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一具人類屍體佩戴著一個洛斯的鉑金徽章，每個蜘蛛腳的末端都鑲嵌著耀眼的鑽石（價值3,000金幣）。一具蛛化卓爾屍體穿著一條由固化陰影編織而成的子彈帶，價值30,000金幣。這條子彈帶上裝有兩個{@item 極效治療藥水||最高治療藥水}和一份{@spell 偽裝術}的{@item 法術卷軸}。

numericDifferences.english: When the spellcasters' {@spell Wish} spell goes awry in chapter 2 of this adventure, the player characters are shunted to the sanctum in Sigil. Kas doesn't expect this development, but the characters are the perfect patsies. Kas planned to retrieve the pieces of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} himself, but now he sends the characters to do so. Kas plans to use the rod to free the demon lord Miska the Wolf-Spider, his ally against Vecna, though he falsely claims that the rod is the key to stopping Vecna. (Read more about Kas's plan in {@adventure chapters 2|VEoR|2} and {@adventure 9|VEoR|9}.)
numericDifferences.localized: 當施法者的{@spell Wish||祈願術}法術在這次冒險的第二章出現問題時，玩家角色被傳送到了西格的聖所。凱斯沒有預料到這一發展，但這些角色是完美的替罪羊。凱斯原本計劃自己取回{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的各個部分，但現在他派角色們去做。凱斯計劃使用這根法杖來釋放惡魔領主米斯卡·狼蛛，這是他對抗維克那的盟友，儘管他錯誤地聲稱這根法杖是阻止維克那的關鍵。（在{@adventure 第二章|VEoR|2}和{@adventure 9|VEoR|9}中閱讀更多關於凱斯計劃的資訊。）

numericDifferences.english: If the characters maximize the water pressure here and in {@area area C12|064|x}, the basins in areas {@area C14|06a|x} and {@area C15|06e|x} start to overflow. After 10 minutes, those areas become {@book difficult terrain|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain} due to flooding. Five minutes after that, the denizens of area C14 come to investigate areas C8 and C12, bringing along both ghouls from area {@area C17|073|x}. The cultists shout about "teaching those meddling elementals a lesson" as they arrive, allowing the characters time to set up an ambush or another ploy.
numericDifferences.localized: 如果角色在這裡和{@area 區域C12|064|x}最大化水壓，那麼{@area C14|06a|x}和{@area C15|06e|x}的盆子開始溢位。10分鐘後，這些區域由於洪水變成了《玩家手冊》中第8頁所述的{@book 困難地形|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}。5分鐘後，區域C14的居民來到調查區域C8和C12，並帶來了來自區域{@area C17|073|x}的食屍鬼。邪教徒在到達時高喊要"教訓那些多管閒事的元素生物"，這給角色們留下了設定伏擊或其它計策的時間。

numericDifferences.english: The easiest way to enter the colossus is through the mountain caves that lead to area L5. The characters can also search higher up the mountain along outdoor paths for the entrances to caverns that lead to areas L11 and L16. Searching for area L11 takes {@dice 2d4} hours, and during the characters' search, a hungry {@creature roc} ambushes them. Searching for area L16 takes {@dice 3d4} hours, and during the characters' search, they stumble on a nest with two {@creature Roc||rocs} and one roc egg the height of a human. The angry roc parents attack the characters, though the rocs don't pursue if the characters flee.
numericDifferences.localized: 進入巨像最簡單的方法是透過通往區域L5的山洞。角色們也可以沿著山上的戶外路徑搜尋通往區域L11的洞穴入口。搜尋區域L11需要{@dice 2d4}小時，在角色們的搜尋過程中，一隻飢餓的{@creature roc||鵬鳥}伏擊了他們。搜尋區域L16需要{@dice 3d4}小時，在角色們的搜尋過程中，他們偶然發現了一個巢穴，裡面有兩隻{@creature Roc||鵬鳥}和一隻與人類身高相當的鵬鳥蛋。憤怒的鵬鳥父母攻擊了角色們，儘管如果角色們逃跑，鵬鳥們不會追擊。

numericDifferences.english: Expend 1 charge of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}
numericDifferences.localized: 消耗{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的一個充能
